content.json:
# Azure SRE Agent demo dashboard

Use this workbook to validate all ten controlled incident scenarios. Select a time range, run scenarios with `scripts/Invoke-Scenario.ps1`, and refresh the workbook.

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message has '"eventType":"sre-demo-scenario"'
| extend event = parse_json(message)
| summarize Signals=count(), Critical=countif(toint(event.severity) == 1), Warning=countif(toint(event.severity) == 2), UniqueScenarios=dcount(tostring(event.scenario))
content.title: Reliability scorecard

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message has '"eventType":"sre-demo-scenario"'
| extend event = parse_json(message)
| summarize Count=count() by Scenario=tostring(event.scenario), Severity=toint(event.severity)
| order by Count desc
content.title: Scenario signals

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests=count(), Failures=countif(success == false), P50=percentile(duration, 50), P95=percentile(duration, 95), P99=percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Request volume, failures, and latency

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message has '"eventType":"sre-demo-scenario"'
| extend event = parse_json(message)
| project timestamp, Scenario=tostring(event.scenario), Severity=toint(event.severity), Status=toint(event.status_code), DurationMs=toint(event.duration_ms), Items=toint(event.item_count), Summary=tostring(event.summary), RootCause=tostring(event.expected_root_cause), CorrelationId=tostring(event.correlationId)
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Incident evidence and expected root causes

content.json:
## Cost guardrails

The demo uses one Consumption Function App, one Standard LRS storage account, 0.1 GB/day Log Analytics ingestion cap, one scheduled-query alert, and one shared SRE Agent. The day-29 Logic App deletes the demo and SRE Agent resource groups before fixed SRE Agent billing begins.
